summary.title: Project Gutenberg Reading List
summary.long_summary: The user has compiled a personal reading list of five classic works available on Project Gutenberg. The titles include William Shakespeare’s *Romeo and Juliet*, a timeless tragedy about star-crossed lovers; Alexandre Dumas’s *The Count of Monte Cristo*, an epic tale of betrayal and revenge; Franz Kafka’s *Metamorphosis*, a surreal novella about alienation; Oscar Wilde’s *The Picture of Dorian Gray*, a philosophical exploration of beauty and morality; and Miguel de Cervantes’s *Don Quixote*, a foundational work of Western literature that blends satire, adventure, and the human condition. Each book represents a distinct literary genre and period, offering the reader a broad spectrum of narrative styles, themes, and historical contexts. The list serves as a curated guide for anyone interested in exploring some of the most influential works of literature that are freely accessible through the Project Gutenberg digital library.
